content: Kumwail mehn Israel kan, kumwail rong mahsen wet me KAUN-O ketin mahsanih duwen kumwail, wehi unseko me e ketin kahluwahdo sang Isip:

“Sang nanpwungen wehi kan koaros en sampah, kumwail tohn wehi wette me I pilada oh apwahpwalih. Eri, iei kahrepen dipamwail kan eh inenen suwed, kahrehda I pahn kalokehkin kumwail dipamwail kan koaros.”
Ia duwe, aramas riemen kak wia seiloak ehu ni ara sohte pahn inoukipene wasahn ara tuhpene?
Ia duwe, laion men kin weriwer nanwel, ma seike dierekier? Ia duwe, laion pwulopwul men pahn ngiringir nan dewe, ma e saikdier mehkot?
Ia duwe, menpihr men kin lohdiong nan lidip ehu, ma sohte mehn pahn nan lidipo? Ia duwe, lidip ehu kak pitirekda ma sohte mehkot me pahn sair?
Ia duwe, sowi en mahwen pahn pepeuk nan kahnimw, aramas akan sohte pahn masepwehkada? Mie paisuwed ehu me kin lel kahnimw ehu, ahpw sohte kin pwilisang rehn KAUN-O?
KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, sohte kin ketin wia mehkot, ma e sohte kin ketin kasalehiong sapwellime ladu soukohp kan kupwure.
Ni laion men eh kin weriwer, ihs me sohte kin masepwehkada? Ni KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, eh kin ketin mahsen, ihs me kak en sohte lohkihda sapwellime mahsen?

Wia pakair wet ong irail kan me kin kousoan nan tehnpas akan nan Asdod oh Isip: “Kumwail pokonpene pohn dohl akan me kapilpene Sameria oh tehk mwahu pingiping laud me wiewiawi nan kahnimwo, oh tiahk suwed kan me wiewiawi loale.”
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, “Aramas pwukat kadirehkilahr nan imwarail kan soangen dipwisou kan me re kulihadahr oh aledier ni angkehlail. Re pil soh mwahn ese dahkot pwungen aramas.
Ihme kahrehda, ar imwintihti pahn kohdo oh kapilpene sapwarailo, oh karangkepeseng ar kehl kan; re ahpw pahn kulihasang audepen nan imwarail kan.”

KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Duwen silepen sihpw men eh kin rikpene nehn de apali salengen sihpw men me laion men kangalahr, iei duwen mehn Sameria malaulau pahn mourla, me met nsensenamwahu mwomwohd nan sehr mwuterek kaselel kan.
Eri, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, pil ketin mahsanih, “Kumwail rong, oh padahkihong kadaudok en Seikop kan.
Ni rahn me I pahn kaloke mehn Israel pwehki diparail kan, I pahn kauwehla pei sarawi kan nan Pedel. Keimw kan en pei sarawi ko pahn pwalpeseng oh lekdekdiong nanpwel.
I pahn kauwehla ihmw kan me kin kokouda ong ahnsoun kopou, oh pil ihmw kan ong ni ahnsoun karakar. Ihmw kan me kapwatki aipori pahn pwupwudi ohla, oh ihmw laud kan koaros pahn kamwomwmwomwla.”
